what: As the section exits the top of the screen, it is pushed down by .4 of the screen height and rises late, and the next section with a rounded top edge covers over it. It starts when the section’s bottom edge is .2+.4 screens below the top of the screen and ends when it passes .2 screen above the top (scrub, no curve). Phone (767px and below) uses .2 · .1 · .1

options.strength: Push distance (multiple of screen height), default .4
options.start · end: Start and end margin (multiple of screen height), default .2 · .2

note: So that the next section sits on top, give each section position:relative and successively higher z-index (or put the later section later in the DOM), and round the top edge of the next section to cover like the original

from.where: Section of the cream pillar on every page, ParallaxSection — original gsap.to(el,{y:()=>innerHeight*.4, scrollTrigger:{start:'bottom-=vh*.4 top+=vh*.2', end:'bottom top-=vh*.2', scrub:true}}) · below 768 .2/.1/.1
